title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A catalog named something other than libs is navigable again
summary: Gradle takes the accessor root from the catalog file name, and a create block in settings renames it again. The navigation assumed libs every time, so an alias of such a catalog opened onto nothing.

highlights.title: The accessor root is read, not assumed
highlights.description: Two of the three shapes a project can have returned no usage where there was one. The root now comes from the catalog file name and from the create block in settings.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: A catalog declared in Kotlin rather than in TOML yields nothing instead of a wrong answer, the same silence the unused dependency scan keeps.
The settings files come out of the sweep that already reads the build files, so this costs no extra read.
